metric: TTFC = time from story post to earliest comment (Algolia tags=comment,story_<id>, hitsPerPage=1)
finding: REPLICATED: Ask HN first-comment latency roughly doubled year-over-year (pooled n=335/329, median 6.5h->13.3h, p=0.045; April and October window-pairs both show the slowdown), while Show HN is statistically unchanged (p=0.16). Consequently the Show-vs-Ask TTFC gap, absent in both 2025 windows (p=0.87/0.41), opened in 2026 (p=0.010 Apr, p=0.0003 Oct). Ask never-commented share stayed ~30-37%, Show ~58-67%.
caveats: single week per year per site (n=238/205 Ask, 514/979 Show)
points are not part of this metric; Show/Ask audiences differ structurally
run-224 replication design: 2 weeks per year per site; still small-n per cell; Ask April n=583/874 vs Oct 238/205
